result.topic_en: A heading on imaginary quantities stating the search for a general criterion to distinguish complex functions of several variables from non-complex ones, followed by small scratch calculations; a column of numbers is visible on the facing page edge.

items.quote: Quaeritur criterium generale, secundum quod functiones plurium variabilium complexae ab incomplexis dignosci possint.
items.english: A general criterion is sought by which complex functions of several variables can be distinguished from non-complex ones.
